results.use_case: search HubSpot CRM contact by email or name
results.execution_guidance: IMPORTANT: Follow the recommended plan below. Extract steps before execution, adapt to your current context, execute sequentially with current_step parameter, and check known pitfalls to avoid errors.
recommended_plan_steps: [Optional (if 400 errors occur or custom properties are involved)] [Prerequisite]: Validate contact property internal names using HUBSPOT_LIST_CONTACT_PROPERTIES (avoid invalid filter keys/operators).
[Required] [Step]: Search for an exact match using HUBSPOT_SEARCH_CONTACTS_BY_CRITERIA (filterGroups on the email property; request minimal identity properties).

[Optional (if data.paging.next.after is present and full coverage is required)] [Next Step]: Paginate by re-running HUBSPOT_SEARCH_CONTACTS_BY_CRITERIA with after until exhausted; aggregate and dedupe by data.results[].id.
[Required] [Next Step]: Interpret results from HUBSPOT_SEARCH_CONTACTS_BY_CRITERIA (if data.total=0 or results empty, treat as no match; else verify the email property and capture data.results[].id).

[Optional (if multiple candidates returned or richer fields/associations are needed)] [Next Step]: Hydrate/disambiguate selected record(s) using HUBSPOT_READ_CONTACT (treat missing associations as empty; dedupe association IDs if needed).

[Fallback (if exact-match search is unexpectedly empty, or create is explicitly approved after confirming no match)] [Fallback]: Retry HUBSPOT_SEARCH_CONTACTS_BY_CRITERIA with broader criteria; if still missing and explicitly approved, create via HUBSPOT_CREATE_CONTACT then confirm via HUBSPOT_READ_CONTACT.
known_pitfalls: [HUBSPOT_SEARCH_CONTACTS_BY_CRITERIA] Canonical identifier is data.results[].id; don’t rely on an ID-like property value for downstream reads.
[HUBSPOT_SEARCH_CONTACTS_BY_CRITERIA] Invalid/unsupported propertyName or operator can trigger 400 Bad Request; confirm internal property names first.
[HUBSPOT_SEARCH_CONTACTS_BY_CRITERIA] ToolRouterV2_NoActiveConnection can surface as code 4302 (status 400) when no active connection is available.

[HUBSPOT_SEARCH_CONTACTS_BY_CRITERIA] Some validation errors misleadingly report missing query/filterGroups; ensure one of them is provided in the expected top-level shape (and each filters entry is an object).

[HUBSPOT_CREATE_CONTACT] Can fail with HTTP 409 Conflict when a contact already exists for the unique email; recover by re-searching and using the existing data.results[].id instead of retrying create.

HUBSPOT_SEARCH_CONTACTS_BY_CRITERIA.description: Searches for HubSpot contacts using a text query, specific filter criteria (filters in a group are ANDed, groups are ORed), sorting, and pagination to retrieve selected properties.

after.description: The cursor token for pagination. Use the `after` value from the `paging.next` object of a previous response to fetch the next set of results. If `None` or an empty string, it fetches the first page.

limit.description: The maximum number of contacts to return.

query.description: A string to search across HubSpot's default searchable contact properties ONLY: firstname, lastname, email, phone, hs_additional_emails, hs_object_id, hs_searchable_calculated_phone_number, company. IMPORTANT: This does NOT search custom properties. To search/filter by custom properties (e.g., 'icp_segment', 'lead_source'), use filterGroups with specific property filters instead. At least one of 'query' or 'filterGroups' must be provided.

direction.description: The direction for sorting (`ASCENDING` or `DESCENDING`). See `DirectionEnm` for options.

propertyName.description: The HubSpot contact property to sort by. Supports both standard and custom property internal names.

items.description: Defines a sorting criterion for search results, including the property name and sort direction.

sorts.description: A list of sort criteria to apply. Each criterion specifies a contact `propertyName` and a sort `direction`. Example: `[{'propertyName': 'lastname', 'direction': 'ASCENDING'}]` sorts contacts by last name.

properties.description: A list of contact property internal names to include in the response. Supports both standard properties (firstname, email, etc.) and custom properties. If omitted, a default set is returned.

value.description: The value to compare the property against. Required for most operators (e.g., `EQ`, `LT`). Must NOT be set with `IN`, `NOT_IN`, `HAS_PROPERTY`, `NOT_HAS_PROPERTY` operators. For datetime properties (createdate, lastmodifieddate, etc.), use epoch milliseconds (e.g., '1609459200000'). Relative time strings like '24h', '7d', '24 hours ago' are automatically converted to epoch milliseconds.

values.description: A list of values for `IN` or `NOT_IN` operations. Required and only used when `operator` is `IN` or `NOT_IN`. Maximum 100 values allowed per filter (HubSpot API constraint). If you need more than 100 values, split into multiple filter groups (groups are ORed, preserving the logic).

operator.description: The operator to use for filtering (e.g., `EQ`, `NEQ`, `LT`, `BETWEEN`, `IN`). Determines how the `propertyName` is compared with `value`, `values`, or `highValue`. See `OperatorEnm` for all options.

highValue.description: The higher bound value for a `BETWEEN` operation. Required and only used when `operator` is `BETWEEN`.

propertyName.description: The HubSpot contact property to filter on. Supports both standard properties (email, lifecyclestage, etc.) and custom properties. IMPORTANT: To filter by contact ID, use 'hs_object_id' (not 'id').

items.description: Represents a single filter criterion for searching contacts, specifying a property, operator, and value(s).

filters.description: A list of filter criteria objects. All filters within this list are combined using AND logic.

items.description: Defines a group of filters. Filters within a group are ANDed. Multiple filter groups in a search request are ORed.

filterGroups.description: A list of filter groups. HubSpot enforces strict limits: maximum 5 filterGroups and maximum 18 total filters across all groups combined. Filters within a group are ANDed. Multiple groups are ORed. Use filterGroups to search/filter by ANY property (including custom properties) with precise operators. At least one of 'query' or 'filterGroups' must be provided. For custom property filtering (e.g., icp_segment='Construction'), use filterGroups instead of query. Example: `[{'filters': [{'propertyName': 'icp_segment', 'operator': 'EQ', 'value': 'Construction'}]}]`. If you need more filter groups or filters, split your search into multiple requests.

custom_properties.description: A list of internal names for custom contact properties to retrieve (e.g., `custom_lead_score`). This is a convenience alias that gets merged into `properties` before the API call - you can also include custom properties directly in the `properties` field instead.

HUBSPOT_READ_CONTACT.description: Retrieves a HubSpot contact by its ID.

archived.description: Set to true to include only archived contacts; defaults to false (active contacts).

contactId.description: Unique internal HubSpot CRM object ID for the contact, which must be valid and existing.

properties.description: Contact property names to include in the response; if omitted, all available properties are returned.

associations.description: Object types (e.g., 'companies', 'deals') to include associated object IDs in the response.

propertiesWithHistory.description: Property names for which to include current and historical values in the response.

HUBSPOT_LIST_CONTACT_PROPERTIES.description: Lists all contact properties in your HubSpot account, including custom properties you've created. Use this action to discover: - Available property names for updating contacts - Custom properties specific to your HubSpot account - Property types and valid options for enumeration fields - Which properties are read-only vs writable

archived.description: Whether to include archived properties. Set to true to see archived properties, false for active only.

custom_only.description: Filter to only return custom properties (excludes HubSpot default properties). Custom properties are ones you created in your HubSpot account.

HUBSPOT_LIST_CONTACTS.description: Retrieves a paginated list of HubSpot contacts.
